name: Vase
summary: This type of Chinese porcelain painted in cobalt blue was generally referred to as 'blue-and -white' ware. It was widely used to decorate the interior of European homes from the 17th century onwards. Pairs of vases such as these adorned the mantelpieces of many households and fascinated such figures
